XiaoHyperCleaner — a tool for safe privacy configuration on MIUI/HyperOS. Works only locally on your device.
Shizuku is used with gratitude to the developers.
Follow the steps to set up Shizuku
Download and install Shizuku from a store.
Enable Developer mode in phone settings.
In Shizuku, select start via wireless debugging.
Choose a convenient way to install Shizuku:
Find "XiaoHyperCleaner" in the list and turn on the switch
The system temporarily restricted access. Tap ⋮ in the app card and allow access — it takes 10 seconds.
Find "Allow restricted settings" — usually in the ⋮ menu at the top or at the bottom of this screen
Where is the restricted settings permission on your device?
At the bottom of the settings list
Scroll down and enable "Allow restricted settings"
Automates settings navigation to assist users with limited mobility

The XiaoHyperCleaner accessibility service is used ONLY to automatically navigate Android system settings at the user\'s explicit request. The service DOES NOT bypass privacy controls, DOES NOT change settings without explicit consent, and DOES NOT collect user data. All actions are performed locally on the device. The service is activated only after explicit user consent and can be disabled at any time in Android settings. The service usage fully complies with the Accessibility Services API Policy.

To automatically configure the app, the accessibility service will click buttons in system settings on your behalf. The service:

• Does NOT bypass privacy controls
• Does NOT change settings without your consent
• Does NOT send data externally
• Can be disabled at any time
I understand and consent to use the accessibility service to automate settings navigation

After 3 attempts the system didn't allow enabling the service. Most likely you need to allow "Restricted settings" in the app card. Follow the steps:

1. Tap "Open settings" below
2. In the app card tap ⋮ (top right)
3. Select "Allow restricted settings"
4. Return to the app and tap "Try again"

To configure privacy settings, you need to allow changing restricted settings. This is an Android 13+ system requirement for apps installed outside Google Play.
Tap ⋮ (top right) and select "Allow restricted settings"
Confirm with your fingerprint or password
Tap the button below. The app will do it automatically — if everything is set up correctly.

The accessibility service couldn't tap the button automatically. Possible reasons:

Try again or skip the check.
For stable accessibility service operation, we recommend disabling battery optimization for XiaoHyperCleaner. Otherwise the system may stop automation after a few minutes.
